sources: Décret n° 93-1362 du 30 décembre 1993 relatif aux déclarations de nationalité et aux décisions de naturalisation

questions.text_fr: Pourquoi souhaitez-vous devenir français(e) ?
questions.answer_hint: Réponse personnelle et sincère. Évoquez votre attachement aux valeurs républicaines, votre projet de vie, votre intégration. Évitez les motifs purement utilitaires (passeport, voyages).

en.text: Why do you wish to become French?
en.answer_hint: Personal, sincere answer. Mention your attachment to republican values, life project, integration. Avoid purely practical reasons (passport, travel).

tr.answer_hint: Kişisel ve içten cevap. Cumhuriyet değerlerine bağlılığınızı, hayat projenizi, entegrasyonunuzu belirtin. Sadece pratik nedenlerden (pasaport, seyahat) kaçının.

questions.text_fr: Pourquoi avoir choisi la France et pas un autre pays ?
questions.answer_hint: Mettez en avant ce qui vous a attiré : valeurs, mode de vie, opportunités professionnelles, attaches familiales, sécurité, culture. Personnalisez selon votre histoire.

en.text: Why did you choose France and not another country?
en.answer_hint: Highlight what attracted you: values, lifestyle, career opportunities, family ties, safety, culture. Personalize based on your story.

tr.text: Neden başka bir ülke değil de Fransa'yı seçtiniz?
tr.answer_hint: Sizi neyin çektiğini vurgulayın: değerler, yaşam tarzı, kariyer fırsatları, aile bağları, güvenlik, kültür. Kendi hikayenize göre kişiselleştirin.

questions.text_fr: Depuis combien de temps vivez-vous en France ?
questions.answer_hint: Donnez la date exacte de votre arrivée et la durée totale. Rappel : 5 ans de résidence régulière sont en principe exigés (réductions possibles : études supérieures en France, service militaire, etc.).

en.text: How long have you been living in France?
en.answer_hint: Give the exact date of arrival and total duration. Reminder: 5 years of regular residence are normally required (reductions possible: higher studies in France, military service, etc.).

tr.answer_hint: Geliş tarihinizi ve toplam süreyi belirtin. Hatırlatma: Genellikle 5 yıl düzenli ikamet gerekir (yüksek öğrenim, askerlik gibi durumlarda indirim mümkün).

questions.text_fr: Racontez votre parcours depuis votre arrivée en France.
questions.answer_hint: Récit chronologique : arrivée, logement, apprentissage du français, études/emploi, famille. Montrez votre progression et votre stabilité.

en.text: Tell us about your journey since arriving in France.
en.answer_hint: Chronological account: arrival, housing, learning French, studies/work, family. Show your progress and stability.

tr.text: Fransa'ya geldiğinizden bu yana hikayenizi anlatın.
tr.answer_hint: Kronolojik anlatı: geliş, konut, Fransızca öğrenme, eğitim/iş, aile. İlerlemenizi ve istikrarınızı gösterin.

questions.text_fr: Quel est votre pays d'origine ?
questions.answer_hint: Nommez votre pays. Vous pouvez ajouter une phrase sur la région, la ville natale. Restez factuel.

en.text: What is your country of origin?
en.answer_hint: Name your country. You may add a sentence about the region or hometown. Stay factual.

tr.answer_hint: Ülkenizi söyleyin. Bölge veya doğduğunuz şehir hakkında bir cümle ekleyebilirsiniz. Olgusal kalın.

questions.text_fr: Pourquoi avez-vous quitté votre pays d'origine ?
questions.answer_hint: Soyez sincère : études, travail, mariage, regroupement familial, asile politique. Évitez de dénigrer votre pays d'origine.

en.text: Why did you leave your country of origin?
en.answer_hint: Be sincere: studies, work, marriage, family reunification, political asylum. Avoid disparaging your home country.

tr.answer_hint: İçten olun: eğitim, iş, evlilik, aile birleşimi, siyasi sığınma. Memleketinizi kötülemeyin.

questions.text_fr: Comment êtes-vous arrivé(e) en France (visa, regroupement, études) ?
questions.answer_hint: Précisez le type de visa initial (étudiant, salarié, conjoint de Français, regroupement familial). Mentionnez l'évolution de votre titre de séjour.

en.text: How did you arrive in France (visa, family reunification, studies)?
en.answer_hint: Specify the initial visa type (student, employee, French spouse, family reunification). Mention how your residence permit evolved.

tr.text: Fransa'ya nasıl geldiniz (vize, aile birleşimi, eğitim)?
tr.answer_hint: İlk vize türünü belirtin (öğrenci, çalışan, Fransız eş, aile birleşimi). Oturma izninizin nasıl geliştiğini anlatın.

questions.text_fr: Quel projet professionnel avez-vous en France ?
questions.answer_hint: Décrivez votre situation actuelle (CDI, CDD, entrepreneur, étudiant) et vos perspectives. Montrez une stabilité économique et une vision claire.

en.text: What is your professional project in France?
en.answer_hint: Describe your current situation (permanent contract, fixed-term, self-employed, student) and prospects. Show economic stability and a clear vision.

tr.answer_hint: Mevcut durumunuzu (CDI süresiz iş sözleşmesi, CDD belirli süreli, girişimci, öğrenci) ve geleceğinizi anlatın. Ekonomik istikrar ve net bir vizyon gösterin.

questions.text_fr: Avez-vous de la famille en France ? Et dans votre pays d'origine ?
questions.answer_hint: Précisez votre situation familiale : conjoint, enfants, parents, fratrie, en France comme à l'étranger. Si famille en France, mettez l'accent sur l'ancrage.

en.text: Do you have family in France? And in your country of origin?
en.answer_hint: Specify your family situation: spouse, children, parents, siblings, in France and abroad. If family is in France, emphasize your roots.

tr.answer_hint: Aile durumunuzu belirtin: eş, çocuklar, ebeveynler, kardeşler, Fransa'da ve yurtdışında. Aileniz Fransa'daysa kök salmanızı vurgulayın.

questions.text_fr: Avez-vous des enfants ? Sont-ils scolarisés en France ?
questions.answer_hint: Précisez le nombre d'enfants, leur âge, leur école/collège/lycée. L'éducation à la française est un signe fort d'intégration.

en.text: Do you have children? Are they educated in France?
en.answer_hint: State the number, ages, and school/collège/lycée (middle/high school). French schooling is a strong sign of integration.

tr.text: Çocuklarınız var mı? Fransa'da okuyorlar mı?
tr.answer_hint: Sayısını, yaşlarını ve okullarını (école/collège/lycée) belirtin. Fransız okul sistemi güçlü bir entegrasyon işaretidir.

questions.text_fr: Quelle est votre profession actuelle ?
questions.answer_hint: Donnez votre poste, secteur, employeur, type de contrat (CDI/CDD/intérim/indépendant). Soyez précis et concis.

en.text: What is your current profession?
en.answer_hint: State your position, sector, employer, type of contract (permanent/fixed-term/temp/self-employed). Be precise and concise.

tr.answer_hint: Pozisyon, sektör, işveren, sözleşme türü (CDI/CDD/geçici/serbest meslek) belirtin. Net ve öz olun.

questions.text_fr: Quel est votre niveau de revenus ?
questions.answer_hint: Donnez une fourchette mensuelle nette. L'autonomie financière est un critère essentiel (revenus stables au moins équivalents au SMIC).

en.text: What is your income level?
en.answer_hint: Give a monthly net range. Financial autonomy is an essential criterion (stable income at least equivalent to the SMIC — French minimum wage).

tr.answer_hint: Aylık net bir aralık verin. Mali bağımsızlık temel bir kriterdir (en azından SMIC — Fransa asgari ücretine eşit istikrarlı gelir).

questions.text_fr: Quels sont vos diplômes ?
questions.answer_hint: Listez vos diplômes du plus élevé au plus récent, en précisant le pays d'obtention et l'équivalence éventuelle.

en.text: What are your qualifications/degrees?
en.answer_hint: List your diplomas from highest to most recent, specifying country of issue and any French equivalence.

tr.answer_hint: Diplomalarınızı en yüksekten en yenisine sıralayın, hangi ülkede alındığını ve varsa Fransa'daki denkliğini belirtin.

questions.text_fr: Avez-vous déjà été condamné(e) ou avez-vous un casier judiciaire ?
questions.answer_hint: La sincérité est obligatoire (votre B2 sera vérifié). Une condamnation récente ou grave peut bloquer la naturalisation. En cas de doute, consultez un avocat avant le rendez-vous.

en.text: Have you ever been convicted or do you have a criminal record?
en.answer_hint: Honesty is mandatory (your B2 criminal record will be checked). A recent or serious conviction can block naturalization. If in doubt, consult a lawyer before the appointment.

tr.text: Hiç mahkum oldunuz mu, sabıka kaydınız var mı?
tr.answer_hint: Dürüstlük zorunludur (B2 sabıka kaydınız kontrol edilecek). Yakın tarihli veya ağır bir mahkumiyet vatandaşlığı engelleyebilir. Şüphedeyseniz randevudan önce bir avukata danışın.

questions.text_fr: Avez-vous déjà demandé la nationalité d'un autre pays ?
questions.answer_hint: La France autorise la double nationalité. Soyez transparent sur d'autres procédures en cours ou abouties.

en.text: Have you ever applied for citizenship of another country?
en.answer_hint: France allows dual citizenship. Be transparent about other procedures, ongoing or completed.

tr.text: Daha önce başka bir ülke vatandaşlığı için başvurdunuz mu?
tr.answer_hint: Fransa çifte vatandaşlığa izin verir. Devam eden veya tamamlanmış başka prosedürler hakkında şeffaf olun.

questions.text_fr: Allez-vous renoncer à votre nationalité d'origine ?
questions.answer_hint: La France n'exige pas la renonciation. Précisez si votre pays d'origine vous l'imposerait. Sinon, indiquez votre choix personnel (souvent conservation).

en.text: Will you renounce your original nationality?
en.answer_hint: France does not require renunciation. State whether your home country would require it. Otherwise, indicate your personal choice (often: keeping both).

tr.answer_hint: Fransa vazgeçmeyi şart koşmaz. Memleketinizin gerektirip gerektirmediğini belirtin. Aksi halde kişisel tercihinizi söyleyin (genellikle her ikisini de korumak).

questions.text_fr: Que représente pour vous la France ?
questions.answer_hint: Réponse personnelle et émotionnelle : valeurs (liberté, égalité, fraternité), culture, mode de vie, démocratie, droits humains.

en.text: What does France represent for you?
en.answer_hint: Personal, emotional answer: values (liberty, equality, fraternity), culture, lifestyle, democracy, human rights.

tr.text: Fransa sizin için ne ifade ediyor?
tr.answer_hint: Kişisel ve duygusal cevap: değerler (özgürlük, eşitlik, kardeşlik), kültür, yaşam tarzı, demokrasi, insan hakları.

questions.text_fr: Vous sentez-vous français(e) ? Pourquoi ?
questions.answer_hint: Donnez des exemples concrets : langue parlée au quotidien, repères culturels, votes, engagement associatif, sentiment d'appartenance.

en.text: Do you feel French? Why?
en.answer_hint: Give concrete examples: French as everyday language, cultural reference points, voting plans, community involvement, sense of belonging.

tr.answer_hint: Somut örnekler verin: günlük Fransızca, kültürel referanslar, oy planları, dernek üyeliği, aidiyet duygusu.

questions.text_fr: Que feriez-vous si votre demande était refusée ?
questions.answer_hint: Restez positif : déposer un recours gracieux (auprès du ministre de l'Intérieur, sous 2 mois) ou refaire une demande plus tard. Soulignez que vous continueriez à vivre en France.

en.text: What would you do if your application were refused?
en.answer_hint: Stay positive: file an appeal (recours gracieux with the Minister of the Interior, within 2 months) or reapply later. Emphasize you would continue living in France.

tr.answer_hint: Olumlu kalın: itiraz (recours gracieux — İçişleri Bakanı'na, 2 ay içinde) veya daha sonra yeniden başvuru. Fransa'da yaşamaya devam edeceğinizi vurgulayın.

questions.text_fr: Comment envisagez-vous votre avenir en France ?
questions.answer_hint: Projet à 5-10 ans : stabilité professionnelle, famille, logement, contribution citoyenne (vote, engagement local).

en.text: How do you envision your future in France?
en.answer_hint: 5-10-year plan: career stability, family, housing, civic contribution (voting, local involvement).

tr.answer_hint: 5-10 yıllık plan: kariyer istikrarı, aile, konut, sivil katkı (oy verme, yerel katılım).

questions.text_fr: Êtes-vous engagé(e) dans une association ou bénévolat ?
questions.answer_hint: Si oui, précisez (nom, mission, fréquence). C'est un atout fort. Sinon, mentionnez votre disponibilité ou intérêt pour le bénévolat futur.

en.text: Are you involved in any association or volunteering?
en.answer_hint: If yes, specify (name, mission, frequency). Strong asset. If not, mention availability or interest for future volunteering.

tr.text: Bir dernek veya gönüllülük faaliyetine katılıyor musunuz?
tr.answer_hint: Evetse belirtin (isim, görev, sıklık). Güçlü bir avantajdır. Hayırsa müsaitliğinizi veya gelecekteki ilginizi belirtin.

questions.text_fr: Avez-vous déjà participé à une élection française ?
questions.answer_hint: Si vous êtes ressortissant UE, vous pouvez voter aux élections municipales et européennes. Sinon, exprimez votre impatience de pouvoir voter une fois français.

en.text: Have you ever participated in a French election?
en.answer_hint: If EU national, you can vote in municipal and European elections. Otherwise, express your eagerness to vote once French.

tr.answer_hint: AB vatandaşıysanız belediye ve Avrupa seçimlerinde oy verebilirsiniz. Değilseniz Fransız olunca oy verme isteğinizi belirtin.

questions.text_fr: Comment avez-vous appris le français ?
questions.answer_hint: Cours, école, immersion, conjoint francophone, autodidacte. Mentionnez votre niveau (B2 minimum requis depuis 2026) et certifications (TCF, DELF).

en.text: How did you learn French?
en.answer_hint: Classes, school, immersion, French-speaking partner, self-taught. Mention level (B2 minimum required since 2026) and certifications (TCF, DELF).

tr.answer_hint: Kurslar, okul, kapsamlı maruziyet, Fransızca konuşan eş, kendi kendine. Seviyenizi (2026'dan beri en az B2) ve sertifikaları (TCF, DELF) belirtin.

questions.text_fr: Avez-vous passé un examen de français (TCF, DELF) ?
questions.answer_hint: Donnez le nom, le niveau obtenu et la date. Le niveau B2 oral est exigé depuis le 1er janvier 2026 (circulaire Retailleau).

en.text: Have you taken a French language exam (TCF, DELF)?
en.answer_hint: Give the name, level obtained, and date. B2 oral level is required since 1 January 2026 (Retailleau circular).

tr.text: Fransızca dil sınavı (TCF, DELF) verdiniz mi?
tr.answer_hint: İsim, alınan seviye ve tarih. 1 Ocak 2026'dan beri sözlü B2 seviyesi zorunludur (Retailleau genelgesi).

questions.text_fr: Quel est votre niveau actuel de français ?
questions.answer_hint: B2 minimum requis. Décrivez vos compétences (comprendre, parler, lire, écrire). Donnez des exemples concrets d'usage (travail, démarches).

en.text: What is your current level of French?
en.answer_hint: B2 minimum required. Describe your skills (understanding, speaking, reading, writing). Give concrete usage examples (work, paperwork).

tr.answer_hint: En az B2 gerekli. Yetkinliklerinizi (anlama, konuşma, okuma, yazma) anlatın. Somut kullanım örnekleri verin (iş, evrak işleri).

questions.text_fr: Avez-vous voyagé dans d'autres régions de France ?
questions.answer_hint: Citez 3-5 régions/villes visitées, brève impression. Montre votre curiosité et votre attachement au territoire.

en.text: Have you traveled to other regions of France?
en.answer_hint: Mention 3-5 regions/cities visited, brief impressions. Shows curiosity and attachment to the territory.

tr.text: Fransa'nın diğer bölgelerine seyahat ettiniz mi?
tr.answer_hint: 3-5 bölge/şehir adı, kısa izlenim. Meraklılığınızı ve ülkeye bağlılığınızı gösterir.

questions.text_fr: Quelle est votre ville préférée en France ?
questions.answer_hint: Personnalisez : ville de résidence ou ville visitée. Citez 1-2 raisons (architecture, ambiance, gastronomie, paysage).

en.text: What is your favorite city in France?
en.answer_hint: Personalize: city of residence or visited city. State 1-2 reasons (architecture, atmosphere, food, landscape).

tr.answer_hint: Kişiselleştirin: ikamet ettiğiniz veya ziyaret ettiğiniz şehir. 1-2 neden belirtin (mimari, atmosfer, mutfak, manzara).

questions.text_fr: Que pensez-vous du mode de vie français ?
questions.answer_hint: Aspects positifs : qualité de vie, gastronomie, art de vivre, équilibre travail-vie privée, vacances. Soyez nuancé et sincère.

en.text: What do you think of the French lifestyle?
en.answer_hint: Positive aspects: quality of life, gastronomy, art of living, work-life balance, vacations. Be nuanced and sincere.

tr.text: Fransız yaşam tarzı hakkında ne düşünüyorsunuz?
tr.answer_hint: Olumlu yönler: yaşam kalitesi, mutfak, yaşam sanatı, iş-yaşam dengesi, tatiller. Nüanslı ve içten olun.

questions.text_fr: Qu'est-ce qui vous plaît le plus en France ?
questions.answer_hint: Trois éléments concrets : santé publique, éducation, gastronomie, libertés individuelles, paysages, art, etc.

en.text: What do you like most about France?
en.answer_hint: Three concrete elements: public healthcare, education, gastronomy, individual freedoms, landscapes, arts, etc.

tr.text: Fransa'da en çok ne hoşunuza gidiyor?
tr.answer_hint: Üç somut unsur: kamu sağlığı, eğitim, mutfak, bireysel özgürlükler, manzaralar, sanat, vb.

questions.text_fr: Y a-t-il des choses qui vous déplaisent en France ?
questions.answer_hint: Soyez mesuré : embouteillages, démarches administratives, complexité fiscale. Évitez les critiques radicales ou polémiques.

en.text: Is there anything you dislike about France?
en.answer_hint: Be moderate: traffic jams, paperwork, tax complexity. Avoid radical or polemical criticism.

tr.answer_hint: Ölçülü olun: trafik, bürokrasi, vergi karmaşıklığı. Sert veya polemik eleştirilerden kaçının.

questions.text_fr: Avez-vous des amis français ?
questions.answer_hint: Précisez le contexte (travail, voisinage, école des enfants, sport). L'intégration sociale est un indicateur fort.

en.text: Do you have French friends?
en.answer_hint: Mention the context (work, neighbors, children's school, sports). Social integration is a strong indicator.

tr.answer_hint: Bağlamı belirtin (iş, komşular, çocuk okulu, spor). Sosyal entegrasyon güçlü bir göstergedir.

questions.text_fr: Que feriez-vous le jour de votre cérémonie de naturalisation ?
questions.answer_hint: Émotion sincère : moment fort, fierté, présence de la famille. Évoquez la signature de la charte des droits et devoirs.

en.text: What would you do on the day of your naturalization ceremony?
en.answer_hint: Sincere emotion: meaningful moment, pride, family presence. Mention signing the charter of rights and duties.

tr.answer_hint: İçten duygu: anlamlı an, gurur, ailenizin varlığı. Hak ve görevler şartını (charte) imzalamaktan bahsedin.

questions.text_fr: Qu'attendez-vous concrètement de la naturalisation ?
questions.answer_hint: Droit de vote, accès à la fonction publique, libre circulation UE, transmission à vos enfants, sécurité juridique.

en.text: What do you concretely expect from naturalization?
en.answer_hint: Right to vote, access to civil service jobs, EU free movement, transmission to children, legal security.

tr.answer_hint: Oy hakkı, kamu hizmetlerine erişim, AB serbest dolaşımı, çocuklarınıza aktarım, hukuki güvence.

questions.text_fr: Comment contribuez-vous à la société française ?
questions.answer_hint: Travail, impôts, cotisations sociales, bénévolat, transmission culturelle, parentalité. Concret et factuel.

en.text: How do you contribute to French society?
en.answer_hint: Work, taxes, social contributions, volunteering, cultural transmission, parenting. Concrete and factual.

tr.answer_hint: İş, vergiler, sosyal güvenlik primleri, gönüllülük, kültürel aktarım, ebeveynlik. Somut ve olgusal.

questions.text_fr: Êtes-vous prêt(e) à défendre la France si nécessaire ?
questions.answer_hint: Oui — c'est un devoir civique. Précisez : service civique, réserve opérationnelle, voter, respecter la loi.

en.text: Are you ready to defend France if necessary?
en.answer_hint: Yes — it is a civic duty. Specify: civic service, operational reserve, voting, respecting the law.

tr.answer_hint: Evet — bu bir sivil görevdir. Belirtin: sivil hizmet, operasyonel rezerv, oy verme, yasaya uyma.

questions.text_fr: Avez-vous une activité sportive ou culturelle ?
questions.answer_hint: Sport, musique, lecture, théâtre, association. Personnalisez. Cela illustre votre vie quotidienne et votre intégration.

en.text: Do you have a sports or cultural activity?
en.answer_hint: Sports, music, reading, theater, club. Personalize. Illustrates your daily life and integration.

tr.text: Bir spor veya kültürel etkinliğiniz var mı?
tr.answer_hint: Spor, müzik, okuma, tiyatro, dernek. Kişiselleştirin. Günlük hayatınızı ve entegrasyonunuzu gösterir.

questions.text_fr: Quel a été votre moment le plus marquant en France ?
questions.answer_hint: Personnalisez : naissance d'un enfant, obtention d'un emploi, voyage, cérémonie, moment de partage. Authentique et bref.

en.text: What was your most memorable moment in France?
en.answer_hint: Personalize: birth of a child, getting a job, a trip, a ceremony, a shared moment. Authentic and brief.

tr.answer_hint: Kişiselleştirin: çocuk doğumu, iş bulma, seyahat, tören, paylaşılan bir an. Özgün ve kısa.

questions.text_fr: Quels sont vos liens avec votre pays d'origine aujourd'hui ?
questions.answer_hint: Famille, voyages occasionnels, langue, culture. Soyez honnête : un lien avec le pays d'origine est normal, l'essentiel est votre projet en France.

en.text: What are your ties to your country of origin today?
en.answer_hint: Family, occasional trips, language, culture. Be honest: ties to origin are normal; what matters is your project in France.

tr.answer_hint: Aile, ara sıra ziyaretler, dil, kültür. Dürüst olun: memleketle bağ normaldir; önemli olan Fransa'daki projenizdir.

questions.text_fr: Avez-vous déjà eu un problème avec l'administration française ?
questions.answer_hint: Soyez factuel. Si oui, expliquez sans dénigrer : malentendu, dossier incomplet, lenteur. Restez positif sur la suite.

en.text: Have you ever had a problem with French administration?
en.answer_hint: Be factual. If yes, explain without disparaging: misunderstanding, incomplete file, delays. Stay positive about resolution.

tr.text: Fransız idaresiyle hiç sorun yaşadınız mı?
tr.answer_hint: Olgusal olun. Evetse kötülemeden açıklayın: yanlış anlama, eksik dosya, gecikme. Çözüm konusunda olumlu kalın.

questions.text_fr: Que diriez-vous à un proche qui hésite à demander la nationalité française ?
questions.answer_hint: Conseils personnels : préparer le dossier, apprendre l'histoire et les valeurs, parler français au quotidien, croire au projet.

en.text: What would you say to a relative hesitating to apply for French citizenship?
en.answer_hint: Personal advice: prepare the file, learn history and values, speak French daily, believe in the project.

tr.text: Fransız vatandaşlığına başvurmakta tereddüt eden bir yakınınıza ne söylersiniz?
tr.answer_hint: Kişisel tavsiye: dosyayı hazırlayın, tarih ve değerleri öğrenin, günlük Fransızca konuşun, projeye inanın.

questions.text_fr: Quelle est la capitale de la France ?
questions.answer_hint: Paris. Vous pouvez ajouter : ~2,1 millions d'habitants intra-muros, ~12 millions en Île-de-France.

en.text: What is the capital of France?
en.answer_hint: Paris. You can add: ~2.1 million inhabitants in the city, ~12 million in the Île-de-France region.

tr.answer_hint: Paris. Şehir merkezinde yaklaşık 2,1 milyon, Île-de-France bölgesinde yaklaşık 12 milyon kişi.

questions.text_fr: Combien y a-t-il de régions en France métropolitaine ?
questions.answer_hint: 13 régions métropolitaines depuis la réforme de 2016 (loi NOTRe), plus 5 régions d'outre-mer = 18 au total.

en.text: How many regions are there in mainland France?
en.answer_hint: 13 mainland regions since the 2016 reform (NOTRe law), plus 5 overseas regions = 18 total.

tr.answer_hint: 2016 reformundan (NOTRe yasası) bu yana 13 anakara bölgesi, ayrıca 5 denizaşırı bölge = toplam 18.

questions.text_fr: Pouvez-vous citer quelques régions françaises ?
questions.answer_hint: Île-de-France, Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur, Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, Occitanie, Nouvelle-Aquitaine, Bretagne, Normandie, Hauts-de-France, Grand Est, Pays de la Loire, Centre-Val de Loire, Bourgogne-Franche-Comté, Corse.

en.text: Can you name some French regions?
en.answer_hint: Île-de-France, Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur, Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, Occitanie, Nouvelle-Aquitaine, Brittany, Normandy, Hauts-de-France, Grand Est, Pays de la Loire, Centre-Val de Loire, Bourgogne-Franche-Comté, Corsica.

tr.answer_hint: Île-de-France, Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur, Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, Occitanie, Nouvelle-Aquitaine, Bretagne, Normandiya, Hauts-de-France, Grand Est, Pays de la Loire, Centre-Val de Loire, Bourgogne-Franche-Comté, Korsika.

questions.text_fr: Quelles sont les régions ou territoires d'outre-mer ?
questions.answer_hint: 5 DROM : Guadeloupe, Martinique, Guyane, La Réunion, Mayotte. Plus les COM : Polynésie française, Nouvelle-Calédonie, Saint-Barthélemy, Saint-Martin, Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, Wallis-et-Futuna.

en.text: What are the overseas regions or territories?
en.answer_hint: 5 DROM (overseas departments and regions): Guadeloupe, Martinique, French Guiana, Réunion, Mayotte. Plus COM (overseas collectivities): French Polynesia, New Caledonia, Saint-Barthélemy, Saint-Martin, Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, Wallis and Futuna.

tr.answer_hint: 5 DROM (denizaşırı il ve bölge): Guadeloupe, Martinique, Fransız Guyanası, Réunion, Mayotte. Ayrıca COM (denizaşırı topluluklar): Fransız Polinezyası, Yeni Kaledonya, Saint-Barthélemy, Saint-Martin, Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, Wallis ve Futuna.

questions.text_fr: Combien de départements compte la France ?
questions.answer_hint: 101 départements : 96 en métropole + 5 en outre-mer (971 Guadeloupe, 972 Martinique, 973 Guyane, 974 Réunion, 976 Mayotte).

en.text: How many departments does France have?
en.answer_hint: 101 departments: 96 in mainland France + 5 overseas (971 Guadeloupe, 972 Martinique, 973 Guiana, 974 Réunion, 976 Mayotte).

tr.answer_hint: 101 il: 96 anakarada + 5 denizaşırı (971 Guadeloupe, 972 Martinique, 973 Guyana, 974 Réunion, 976 Mayotte).

questions.text_fr: Quels sont les pays frontaliers de la France ?
questions.answer_hint: 8 pays : Belgique, Luxembourg, Allemagne, Suisse, Italie, Monaco, Espagne, Andorre. Plus le Royaume-Uni par la Manche.

en.text: Which countries border France?
en.answer_hint: 8 countries: Belgium, Luxembourg, Germany, Switzerland, Italy, Monaco, Spain, Andorra. Plus the UK across the Channel.

tr.answer_hint: 8 ülke: Belçika, Lüksemburg, Almanya, İsviçre, İtalya, Monako, İspanya, Andorra. Ayrıca Manş Denizi üzerinden İngiltere.

questions.text_fr: Quels sont les principaux fleuves de France ?
questions.answer_hint: Loire (le plus long, 1006 km), Seine, Rhône, Garonne, Rhin (frontière avec l'Allemagne).

en.text: What are the main rivers of France?
en.answer_hint: Loire (longest, 1006 km), Seine, Rhône, Garonne, Rhine (border with Germany).

tr.answer_hint: Loire (en uzun, 1006 km), Seine, Rhône, Garonne, Ren (Almanya sınırı).

questions.text_fr: Quelles sont les principales chaînes de montagnes en France ?
questions.answer_hint: Alpes (frontière Italie/Suisse, Mont Blanc 4809 m), Pyrénées (frontière Espagne), Jura, Vosges, Massif central.

en.text: What are the main mountain ranges in France?
en.answer_hint: Alps (Italy/Switzerland border, Mont Blanc 4809 m), Pyrenees (Spain border), Jura, Vosges, Massif Central.

tr.answer_hint: Alpler (İtalya/İsviçre sınırı, Mont Blanc 4809 m), Pireneler (İspanya sınırı), Jura, Vosges, Massif Central.

questions.text_fr: Quelles sont les principales mers et océans bordant la France ?
questions.answer_hint: Océan Atlantique (ouest), Manche (nord), mer du Nord (extrême nord), mer Méditerranée (sud).

en.text: What are the main seas and oceans bordering France?
en.answer_hint: Atlantic Ocean (west), English Channel (north), North Sea (far north), Mediterranean Sea (south).

tr.text: Fransa hangi deniz ve okyanuslarla çevrilidir?
tr.answer_hint: Atlas Okyanusu (batı), Manş Denizi (kuzey), Kuzey Denizi (uzak kuzey), Akdeniz (güney).

questions.text_fr: Combien d'habitants compte la France ?
questions.answer_hint: Environ 68 millions d'habitants (2026), dont ~65 en métropole et ~2,7 en outre-mer.

en.text: What is the population of France?
en.answer_hint: About 68 million inhabitants (2026), including ~65 million in mainland France and ~2.7 million overseas.

tr.answer_hint: Yaklaşık 68 milyon kişi (2026), bunun ~65 milyonu anakarada, ~2,7 milyonu denizaşırı bölgelerde.

questions.text_fr: Quel est le régime politique de la France ?
questions.answer_hint: République démocratique, indivisible, laïque, sociale (article 1 de la Constitution). Régime semi-présidentiel sous la Ve République (depuis 1958).

en.text: What is France's political system?
en.answer_hint: Democratic, indivisible, secular, social republic (Article 1 of the Constitution). Semi-presidential system under the Fifth Republic (since 1958).

tr.answer_hint: Demokratik, bölünmez, laik, sosyal cumhuriyet (Anayasa madde 1). 1958'den beri Beşinci Cumhuriyet altında yarı-başkanlık sistemi.

questions.text_fr: Qui est l'actuel président de la République française ?
questions.answer_hint: Emmanuel Macron (depuis le 14 mai 2017, réélu le 24 avril 2022, mandat jusqu'en 2027).

en.text: Who is the current President of the French Republic?
en.answer_hint: Emmanuel Macron (since 14 May 2017, re-elected 24 April 2022, term until 2027).

tr.answer_hint: Emmanuel Macron (14 Mayıs 2017'den beri, 24 Nisan 2022'de yeniden seçildi, görev süresi 2027'ye kadar).

questions.text_fr: Comment est élu le président de la République ?
questions.answer_hint: Au suffrage universel direct, à deux tours, pour un mandat de 5 ans (quinquennat depuis 2000). Maximum 2 mandats consécutifs.

en.text: How is the President of the Republic elected?
en.answer_hint: By direct universal suffrage, two rounds, for a 5-year term (quinquennat since 2000). Maximum 2 consecutive terms.

tr.answer_hint: Doğrudan genel oyla, iki turda, 5 yıllık görev süresi için (2000'den beri quinquennat). En fazla 2 ardışık dönem.

questions.text_fr: Quelle est la durée du mandat présidentiel ?
questions.answer_hint: 5 ans, renouvelable une fois consécutivement (depuis la réforme de 2000 ; auparavant 7 ans, le septennat).

en.text: How long is the presidential term?
en.answer_hint: 5 years, renewable once consecutively (since the 2000 reform; previously 7 years, the septennat).

tr.answer_hint: 5 yıl, ardışık olarak bir kez yenilenebilir (2000 reformundan beri; daha önce 7 yıl olan septennat).

questions.text_fr: Qui est le Premier ministre actuel ?
questions.answer_hint: Vérifiez avant l'entretien : la composition du gouvernement change. Préparez le nom et donnez la date de nomination.

en.text: Who is the current Prime Minister?
en.answer_hint: Check before the interview: government composition changes. Prepare the name and give the date of appointment.

tr.answer_hint: Mülakat öncesi kontrol edin: hükümet bileşimi değişir. İsmi hazırlayın ve atanma tarihini belirtin.

questions.text_fr: Qui nomme le Premier ministre ?
questions.answer_hint: Le président de la République nomme le Premier ministre (article 8 de la Constitution). Le PM doit en pratique être issu de la majorité parlementaire.

en.text: Who appoints the Prime Minister?
en.answer_hint: The President of the Republic appoints the Prime Minister (Article 8 of the Constitution). In practice, the PM must come from the parliamentary majority.

tr.answer_hint: Başbakanı Cumhurbaşkanı atar (Anayasa madde 8). Pratikte Başbakan parlamento çoğunluğundan gelmelidir.

questions.text_fr: Quel est le rôle du président de la République ?
questions.answer_hint: Chef de l'État, garant des institutions, chef des armées, conduit la diplomatie, peut dissoudre l'Assemblée nationale, nomme le Premier ministre.

en.text: What is the role of the President of the Republic?
en.answer_hint: Head of state, guarantor of institutions, commander-in-chief of the armed forces, leads diplomacy, can dissolve the National Assembly, appoints the Prime Minister.

tr.answer_hint: Devlet başkanı, kurumların güvencesi, ordunun başkomutanı, diplomasiyi yürütür, Ulusal Meclisi feshedebilir, Başbakanı atar.

questions.text_fr: Quel est le rôle du Premier ministre ?
questions.answer_hint: Dirige le gouvernement, propose les lois, applique la politique du président, dispose de l'administration et de la force armée (en gestion courante).

en.text: What is the role of the Prime Minister?
en.answer_hint: Leads the government, proposes laws, implements the President's policy, has authority over administration and armed forces (in routine management).

tr.answer_hint: Hükümeti yönetir, yasaları önerir, Cumhurbaşkanı'nın politikasını uygular, idari ve askeri güçler üzerinde yetkilidir (rutin yönetimde).

questions.text_fr: Quel est le rôle d'un ministre ?
questions.answer_hint: Membre du gouvernement, dirige un ministère (Intérieur, Économie, Éducation, etc.), met en œuvre la politique gouvernementale dans son domaine.

en.text: What is the role of a minister?
en.answer_hint: Member of the government, leads a ministry (Interior, Economy, Education, etc.), implements government policy in their field.

tr.answer_hint: Hükümet üyesi, bir bakanlığı (İçişleri, Ekonomi, Eğitim, vb.) yönetir, kendi alanında hükümet politikasını uygular.

questions.text_fr: Qu'est-ce que l'Assemblée nationale ?
questions.answer_hint: Chambre basse du Parlement, 577 députés élus au suffrage universel direct pour 5 ans. Siège : Palais Bourbon, Paris. Vote les lois, peut renverser le gouvernement.

en.text: What is the National Assembly?
en.answer_hint: Lower house of Parliament, 577 deputies elected by direct universal suffrage for 5 years. Seat: Palais Bourbon, Paris. Votes laws, can overthrow the government.

tr.answer_hint: Parlamentonun alt kanadı, doğrudan genel oyla 5 yıllığına seçilen 577 milletvekili. Merkez: Palais Bourbon, Paris. Yasaları onaylar, hükümeti devirebilir.

questions.text_fr: Qu'est-ce que le Sénat ?
questions.answer_hint: Chambre haute du Parlement, 348 sénateurs élus au suffrage indirect (par des grands électeurs), pour 6 ans, renouvelables par moitié tous les 3 ans. Siège : Palais du Luxembourg.

en.text: What is the Senate?
en.answer_hint: Upper house of Parliament, 348 senators elected by indirect suffrage (by grand electors), for 6 years, renewed by half every 3 years. Seat: Palais du Luxembourg.

tr.answer_hint: Parlamentonun üst kanadı, dolaylı oyla (büyük seçicilerle) 6 yıllığına seçilen 348 senatör, her 3 yılda bir yarısı yenilenir. Merkez: Palais du Luxembourg.

questions.text_fr: Qui élit les députés ?
questions.answer_hint: Les citoyens français âgés de 18 ans et plus, au suffrage universel direct, à deux tours, dans 577 circonscriptions.

en.text: Who elects the deputies?
en.answer_hint: French citizens aged 18 and over, by direct universal suffrage, in two rounds, in 577 constituencies.

tr.answer_hint: 18 yaş ve üzeri Fransız vatandaşları, doğrudan genel oyla, iki turda, 577 seçim bölgesinde.

questions.text_fr: Qui élit les sénateurs ?
questions.answer_hint: Les grands électeurs (députés, conseillers régionaux et départementaux, conseillers municipaux des grandes villes), ~150 000 personnes au total.

en.text: Who elects the senators?
en.answer_hint: Grand electors (deputies, regional and departmental councilors, municipal councilors of major cities), about 150,000 people in total.

tr.answer_hint: Büyük seçiciler (milletvekilleri, bölgesel ve il meclisi üyeleri, büyük şehir belediye meclisi üyeleri), toplam yaklaşık 150 000 kişi.

questions.text_fr: Combien y a-t-il de députés à l'Assemblée nationale ?
questions.answer_hint: 577 députés, dont 11 représentent les Français de l'étranger.

en.text: How many deputies are in the National Assembly?
en.answer_hint: 577 deputies, including 11 representing French citizens abroad.

tr.answer_hint: 577 milletvekili, bunların 11'i yurtdışındaki Fransız vatandaşlarını temsil eder.

questions.text_fr: Combien y a-t-il de sénateurs ?
questions.answer_hint: 348 sénateurs, dont 12 pour les Français établis hors de France.

en.text: How many senators are there?
en.answer_hint: 348 senators, including 12 for French citizens established abroad.

tr.answer_hint: 348 senatör, bunların 12'si yurtdışında yerleşik Fransız vatandaşları için.

questions.text_fr: Quel âge doit-on avoir pour voter en France ?
questions.answer_hint: 18 ans révolus, être de nationalité française (sauf pour les municipales et européennes : citoyens UE résidant en France).

en.text: What age must you be to vote in France?
en.answer_hint: 18 years old, French nationality (except municipal and European elections: EU citizens residing in France can vote).

tr.text: Fransa'da oy vermek için kaç yaşında olmak gerekir?
tr.answer_hint: Tamamlanmış 18 yaş, Fransız vatandaşlığı (belediye ve Avrupa seçimleri hariç: Fransa'da yaşayan AB vatandaşları oy verebilir).

questions.text_fr: Quelles sont les principales élections en France ?
questions.answer_hint: Présidentielles, législatives (députés), sénatoriales, européennes, régionales, départementales, municipales.

en.text: What are the main elections in France?
en.answer_hint: Presidential, legislative (deputies), senatorial, European, regional, departmental, municipal.

tr.answer_hint: Cumhurbaşkanlığı, milletvekili, senato, Avrupa, bölgesel, il, belediye seçimleri.

questions.text_fr: Qu'est-ce que le Conseil constitutionnel ?
questions.answer_hint: Institution créée en 1958. Vérifie la constitutionnalité des lois. 9 membres nommés (3 par le président, 3 par l'Assemblée, 3 par le Sénat) pour 9 ans, plus les anciens présidents à vie.

en.text: What is the Constitutional Council?
en.answer_hint: Institution created in 1958. Checks constitutionality of laws. 9 members appointed (3 by the President, 3 by the National Assembly, 3 by the Senate) for 9 years, plus former presidents for life.

tr.answer_hint: 1958'de kurulan kurum. Yasaların anayasaya uygunluğunu denetler. 9 yıllığına atanan 9 üye (3'ü Cumhurbaşkanı, 3'ü Ulusal Meclis, 3'ü Senato tarafından), ayrıca ömür boyu eski cumhurbaşkanları.

questions.text_fr: Qu'est-ce que le Conseil d'État ?
questions.answer_hint: Plus haute juridiction administrative française. Conseille le gouvernement sur les projets de loi et juge les litiges entre les citoyens et l'administration. Créé par Napoléon en 1799.

en.text: What is the Council of State (Conseil d'État)?
en.answer_hint: Highest administrative court in France. Advises the government on bills and judges disputes between citizens and the administration. Created by Napoleon in 1799.

tr.answer_hint: Fransa'nın en yüksek idari mahkemesi. Hükümete yasa tasarıları hakkında danışmanlık yapar ve vatandaşlarla idare arasındaki uyuşmazlıkları çözer. 1799'da Napolyon tarafından kurulmuştur.

questions.text_fr: Quelle est la différence entre une commune, un département et une région ?
questions.answer_hint: Trois niveaux de collectivités territoriales : commune (mairie), département (conseil départemental), région (conseil régional). Chacune a ses compétences (école, transports, etc.).

en.text: What is the difference between a commune, a department, and a region?
en.answer_hint: Three levels of local government: commune (town hall), department (departmental council), region (regional council). Each has its own competencies (schools, transport, etc.).

tr.text: Belediye (commune), il (département) ve bölge (région) arasındaki fark nedir?
tr.answer_hint: Üç yerel yönetim seviyesi: belediye (commune — belediye binası), il (département — il meclisi), bölge (région — bölge meclisi). Her birinin kendi yetkileri vardır (okullar, ulaşım, vb.).

questions.text_fr: Qui est le maire de votre commune ?
questions.answer_hint: Connaissez le nom de votre maire (vérifier avant l'entretien). Vous pouvez mentionner depuis quand il/elle est en poste.

en.text: Who is the mayor of your commune?
en.answer_hint: Know the name of your mayor (verify before interview). You can mention since when they are in office.

tr.answer_hint: Belediye başkanınızın adını bilin (mülakat öncesi kontrol edin). Ne zamandır görevde olduğunu da belirtebilirsiniz.

questions.text_fr: Quel est le rôle du maire ?
questions.answer_hint: Représentant de la commune, exécute les décisions du conseil municipal, officier d'état civil (mariages), gère école, urbanisme, sécurité locale (police municipale).

en.text: What is the role of the mayor?
en.answer_hint: Represents the commune, executes municipal council decisions, civil registry officer (marriages), manages schools, urban planning, local security (municipal police).

tr.answer_hint: Belediyeyi temsil eder, belediye meclisi kararlarını uygular, nüfus müdürüdür (evlilikler), okul, şehir planlama, yerel güvenliği (belediye polisi) yönetir.

questions.text_fr: Qu'est-ce qu'une préfecture ?
questions.answer_hint: Représentation de l'État dans le département, dirigée par le préfet. S'occupe des titres de séjour, permis de conduire, cartes grises, naturalisations.

en.text: What is a prefecture?
en.answer_hint: State representation in the department, headed by the prefect. Handles residence permits, driving licenses, vehicle registration, naturalizations.

tr.answer_hint: İlçede devletin temsili, vali (préfet) tarafından yönetilir. Oturma izni, ehliyet, araç ruhsatı, vatandaşlık işlemleriyle ilgilenir.

questions.text_fr: Qui nomme les préfets ?
questions.answer_hint: Les préfets sont nommés par décret du président de la République en Conseil des ministres, sur proposition du Premier ministre et du ministre de l'Intérieur.

en.text: Who appoints prefects?
en.answer_hint: Prefects are appointed by decree of the President of the Republic in the Council of Ministers, on the proposal of the Prime Minister and Minister of the Interior.

tr.answer_hint: Valiler, Başbakan ve İçişleri Bakanı'nın önerisiyle Bakanlar Kurulu'nda Cumhurbaşkanı kararnamesiyle atanır.

questions.text_fr: Quelle est la devise de la France ?
questions.answer_hint: Liberté, Égalité, Fraternité. Elle figure sur les bâtiments publics, les pièces de monnaie, et est inscrite à l'article 2 de la Constitution.

en.text: What is the motto of France?
en.answer_hint: Liberty, Equality, Fraternity. Found on public buildings, coins, and inscribed in Article 2 of the Constitution.

tr.answer_hint: Özgürlük, Eşitlik, Kardeşlik (Liberté, Égalité, Fraternité). Kamu binalarında, sikkelerde bulunur ve Anayasa madde 2'de yer alır.

questions.text_fr: Quel est l'hymne national français ?
questions.answer_hint: La Marseillaise, écrite par Rouget de Lisle en 1792 à Strasbourg. Hymne officiel depuis 1795.

en.text: What is the French national anthem?
en.answer_hint: La Marseillaise, written by Rouget de Lisle in 1792 in Strasbourg. Official anthem since 1795.

tr.answer_hint: Rouget de Lisle tarafından 1792'de Strazburg'da yazılan La Marseillaise. 1795'ten beri resmi marş.

questions.text_fr: Quel est le drapeau de la France ?
questions.answer_hint: Tricolore : bleu, blanc, rouge. Bandes verticales d'égale largeur. Adopté en 1794, symbolise l'union du roi (blanc) et de la ville de Paris (bleu et rouge).

en.text: What is the flag of France?
en.answer_hint: Tricolor: blue, white, red. Vertical stripes of equal width. Adopted in 1794, symbolizes the union of the king (white) and the city of Paris (blue and red).

tr.answer_hint: Üç renkli: mavi, beyaz, kırmızı. Eşit genişlikte dikey şeritler. 1794'te kabul edildi, kralın (beyaz) ve Paris şehrinin (mavi ve kırmızı) birliğini simgeler.

questions.text_fr: Quelle est la monnaie de la France ?
questions.answer_hint: L'euro (€) depuis le 1er janvier 2002. Avant : le franc. Monnaie commune à 20 pays de la zone euro.

en.text: What is the currency of France?
en.answer_hint: The euro (€) since 1 January 2002. Before: the franc. Common currency for 20 eurozone countries.

tr.answer_hint: 1 Ocak 2002'den beri euro (€). Öncesi: frank. 20 euro bölgesi ülkesinin ortak para birimi.

questions.text_fr: Quelle est la fête nationale française et que commémore-t-elle ?
questions.answer_hint: Le 14 juillet. Commémore la prise de la Bastille en 1789 et la Fête de la Fédération de 1790 (loi du 6 juillet 1880).

en.text: What is the French national holiday and what does it commemorate?
en.answer_hint: 14 July. Commemorates the storming of the Bastille in 1789 and the Festival of the Federation of 1790 (law of 6 July 1880).

tr.text: Fransa'nın ulusal bayramı nedir ve neyi anar?
tr.answer_hint: 14 Temmuz. 1789'da Bastille'in fethini ve 1790 Federasyon Bayramı'nı anar (6 Temmuz 1880 yasası).

questions.text_fr: Que représente Marianne ?
questions.answer_hint: Allégorie de la République française, symbole de liberté et de raison. Portée par un bonnet phrygien. Présente dans toutes les mairies.

en.text: What does Marianne represent?
en.answer_hint: Allegory of the French Republic, symbol of freedom and reason. Wears a Phrygian cap. Present in every town hall.

tr.answer_hint: Fransız Cumhuriyeti'nin alegorisi, özgürlük ve aklın simgesi. Frigya başlığı giyer. Her belediye binasında bulunur.

questions.text_fr: Qu'est-ce que la Constitution ?
questions.answer_hint: Texte fondamental qui organise les pouvoirs publics. La Constitution actuelle est celle de la Ve République, adoptée le 4 octobre 1958, à l'initiative du général de Gaulle.

en.text: What is the Constitution?
en.answer_hint: Fundamental text organizing public powers. The current Constitution is that of the Fifth Republic, adopted on 4 October 1958, at the initiative of General de Gaulle.

tr.answer_hint: Kamu yetkilerini düzenleyen temel metin. Mevcut Anayasa, General de Gaulle'ün girişimiyle 4 Ekim 1958'de kabul edilen Beşinci Cumhuriyet Anayasasıdır.

questions.text_fr: Quand a été adoptée la Constitution actuelle ?
questions.answer_hint: Le 4 octobre 1958, par référendum, sous l'impulsion du général de Gaulle. Elle a fondé la Ve République.

en.text: When was the current Constitution adopted?
en.answer_hint: 4 October 1958, by referendum, under the impetus of General de Gaulle. It founded the Fifth Republic.

tr.text: Mevcut Anayasa ne zaman kabul edildi?
tr.answer_hint: General de Gaulle'ün öncülüğünde 4 Ekim 1958'de halk oylamasıyla. Beşinci Cumhuriyet'i kurdu.

questions.text_fr: Quels sont les trois pouvoirs en France ?
questions.answer_hint: Pouvoir exécutif (président, gouvernement), pouvoir législatif (Parlement : Assemblée nationale + Sénat), pouvoir judiciaire (tribunaux). Séparation des pouvoirs (Montesquieu).

en.text: What are the three powers in France?
en.answer_hint: Executive (President, government), legislative (Parliament: National Assembly + Senate), judicial (courts). Separation of powers (Montesquieu).

tr.answer_hint: Yürütme (Cumhurbaşkanı, hükümet), yasama (Parlamento: Ulusal Meclis + Senato), yargı (mahkemeler). Kuvvetler ayrılığı (Montesquieu).

questions.text_fr: Qui peut proposer une loi ?
questions.answer_hint: Le gouvernement (projet de loi) ou les parlementaires : députés ou sénateurs (proposition de loi). Le texte est ensuite débattu et voté.

en.text: Who can propose a law?
en.answer_hint: The government (projet de loi — government bill) or parliamentarians, deputies or senators (proposition de loi — private bill). The text is then debated and voted.

tr.answer_hint: Hükümet (projet de loi — hükümet tasarısı) veya parlamenterler, milletvekili ya da senatörler (proposition de loi — özel teklif). Metin sonra tartışılır ve oylanır.

questions.text_fr: Comment une loi est-elle adoptée ?
questions.answer_hint: Vote par l'Assemblée nationale et le Sénat (texte identique), puis promulgation par le président dans les 15 jours. Contrôle possible par le Conseil constitutionnel.

en.text: How is a law adopted?
en.answer_hint: Voted by National Assembly and Senate (identical text), then promulgated by the President within 15 days. Possible review by Constitutional Council.

tr.answer_hint: Ulusal Meclis ve Senato tarafından (aynı metin) oylanır, sonra Cumhurbaşkanı tarafından 15 gün içinde yayımlanır. Anayasa Konseyi'nce denetim mümkündür.

questions.text_fr: Qu'est-ce que l'Union européenne et depuis quand la France en fait-elle partie ?
questions.answer_hint: Union politique et économique. La France est l'un des 6 pays fondateurs (Traité de Rome, 25 mars 1957). 27 États membres aujourd'hui.

en.text: What is the European Union and since when has France been a member?
en.answer_hint: Political and economic union. France is one of the 6 founding countries (Treaty of Rome, 25 March 1957). 27 member states today.

tr.text: Avrupa Birliği nedir ve Fransa ne zamandır üyesi?
tr.answer_hint: Siyasi ve ekonomik birlik. Fransa 6 kurucu ülkeden biridir (Roma Antlaşması, 25 Mart 1957). Bugün 27 üye devlet.

questions.text_fr: Combien de pays membres compte l'Union européenne ?
questions.answer_hint: 27 pays depuis le Brexit (sortie du Royaume-Uni en 2020).

en.text: How many member states does the European Union have?
en.answer_hint: 27 countries since Brexit (UK left in 2020).

tr.text: Avrupa Birliği'nin kaç üye devleti var?
tr.answer_hint: Brexit'ten beri (Birleşik Krallık 2020'de ayrıldı) 27 ülke.

questions.text_fr: Quelles sont les institutions principales de l'Union européenne ?
questions.answer_hint: Parlement européen (Strasbourg/Bruxelles), Commission européenne (Bruxelles), Conseil de l'UE, Conseil européen, Cour de justice (Luxembourg), Banque centrale européenne (Francfort).

en.text: What are the main institutions of the European Union?
en.answer_hint: European Parliament (Strasbourg/Brussels), European Commission (Brussels), Council of the EU, European Council, Court of Justice (Luxembourg), European Central Bank (Frankfurt).

tr.answer_hint: Avrupa Parlamentosu (Strazburg/Brüksel), Avrupa Komisyonu (Brüksel), AB Konseyi, Avrupa Konseyi, Adalet Divanı (Lüksemburg), Avrupa Merkez Bankası (Frankfurt).

questions.text_fr: Où siège le Parlement européen ?
questions.answer_hint: Strasbourg (siège officiel, sessions plénières) et Bruxelles (commissions et sessions plénières additionnelles). Secrétariat à Luxembourg.

en.text: Where does the European Parliament sit?
en.answer_hint: Strasbourg (official seat, plenary sessions) and Brussels (committees and additional plenary sessions). Secretariat in Luxembourg.

tr.answer_hint: Strazburg (resmi merkez, genel kurul) ve Brüksel (komiteler ve ek genel kurul). Sekretarya Lüksemburg'da.

questions.text_fr: Quels sont les pays fondateurs de l'Union européenne ?
questions.answer_hint: Les 6 : France, Allemagne, Italie, Belgique, Pays-Bas, Luxembourg. Signature du Traité de Rome le 25 mars 1957.

en.text: Which are the founding countries of the European Union?
en.answer_hint: The 6: France, Germany, Italy, Belgium, Netherlands, Luxembourg. Signing of the Treaty of Rome on 25 March 1957.

tr.answer_hint: 6 ülke: Fransa, Almanya, İtalya, Belçika, Hollanda, Lüksemburg. Roma Antlaşması 25 Mart 1957'de imzalandı.

questions.text_fr: Quel est le drapeau de l'Union européenne ?
questions.answer_hint: Fond bleu avec 12 étoiles dorées disposées en cercle. Les 12 étoiles ne représentent pas le nombre de pays mais l'unité, la perfection et la plénitude.

en.text: What is the flag of the European Union?
en.answer_hint: Blue background with 12 gold stars in a circle. The 12 stars do not represent the number of countries but unity, perfection, and completeness.

tr.answer_hint: Mavi zemin üzerinde halka şeklinde 12 altın yıldız. 12 yıldız ülke sayısını değil birlik, mükemmellik ve bütünlüğü temsil eder.

questions.text_fr: Quelle est la devise de l'Union européenne ?
questions.answer_hint: « Unie dans la diversité », adoptée en 2000.

en.text: What is the motto of the European Union?
en.answer_hint: "United in diversity", adopted in 2000.

tr.answer_hint: "Çeşitlilik içinde birlik" (Unie dans la diversité), 2000'de kabul edildi.

questions.text_fr: Qu'est-ce que l'espace Schengen ?
questions.answer_hint: Zone de libre circulation sans contrôle aux frontières intérieures, créée en 1985. 27 États (dont 25 de l'UE + Suisse, Norvège, Islande, Liechtenstein).

en.text: What is the Schengen area?
en.answer_hint: Zone of free movement without internal border controls, created in 1985. 27 states (including 25 EU + Switzerland, Norway, Iceland, Liechtenstein).

tr.answer_hint: 1985'te kurulan, iç sınır kontrolü olmadan serbest dolaşım bölgesi. 27 devlet (25 AB ülkesi + İsviçre, Norveç, İzlanda, Liechtenstein).

questions.text_fr: Qu'est-ce que l'ONU ?
questions.answer_hint: Organisation des Nations unies, créée en 1945 après la WWII. Siège à New York. La France est membre permanent du Conseil de sécurité (droit de veto).

en.text: What is the UN?
en.answer_hint: United Nations Organization, created in 1945 after WWII. Headquarters in New York. France is a permanent member of the Security Council (veto power).

tr.answer_hint: Birleşmiş Milletler, II. Dünya Savaşı'ndan sonra 1945'te kuruldu. Merkezi New York'tadır. Fransa, Güvenlik Konseyi'nin daimi üyesidir (veto hakkı).

questions.text_fr: Qu'est-ce que l'OTAN ?
questions.answer_hint: Organisation du traité de l'Atlantique Nord, alliance militaire créée en 1949. La France en est membre fondateur. Siège : Bruxelles.

en.text: What is NATO?
en.answer_hint: North Atlantic Treaty Organization, military alliance created in 1949. France is a founding member. Headquarters: Brussels.

tr.answer_hint: 1949'da kurulan Kuzey Atlantik Antlaşması Örgütü, askeri ittifak. Fransa kurucu üyedir. Merkezi: Brüksel.

questions.text_fr: Qu'est-ce que la francophonie ?
questions.answer_hint: Communauté des pays ayant le français en partage. Organisation internationale de la Francophonie (OIF) regroupe 88 États et gouvernements. Journée internationale : 20 mars.

en.text: What is the Francophonie?
en.answer_hint: Community of countries sharing the French language. The International Organisation of La Francophonie (OIF) gathers 88 states and governments. International Day: 20 March.

tr.answer_hint: Fransızcayı paylaşan ülkeler topluluğu. Uluslararası Frankofoni Örgütü (OIF) 88 devlet ve hükümeti bir araya getirir. Uluslararası Gün: 20 Mart.

questions.text_fr: Qu'est-ce que la justice en France ?
questions.answer_hint: Pouvoir indépendant. Deux ordres : judiciaire (litiges privés, infractions) et administratif (litiges avec l'administration). Garante par les magistrats.

en.text: What is justice in France?
en.answer_hint: Independent power. Two orders: judicial (private disputes, offenses) and administrative (disputes with administration). Upheld by magistrates.

tr.answer_hint: Bağımsız bir güçtür. İki düzen vardır: adli (özel uyuşmazlıklar, suçlar) ve idari (idareyle uyuşmazlıklar). Hakimler tarafından güvence altına alınır.

questions.text_fr: Quelle est la juridiction suprême en matière judiciaire ?
questions.answer_hint: La Cour de cassation, à Paris. Plus haute juridiction de l'ordre judiciaire. Elle ne juge pas les faits mais le droit appliqué.

en.text: What is the supreme judicial court?
en.answer_hint: The Court of Cassation (Cour de cassation), in Paris. Highest court of the judicial order. It does not judge facts but the application of law.

tr.text: Adli düzendeki en yüksek mahkeme nedir?
tr.answer_hint: Yargıtay (Cour de cassation), Paris'tedir. Adli düzenin en yüksek mahkemesi. Olayları değil, hukukun uygulanmasını denetler.

questions.text_fr: Qu'est-ce que la Défenseure des droits ?
questions.answer_hint: Autorité administrative indépendante créée en 2011. Défend les droits et libertés des citoyens face aux administrations. Mandat de 6 ans non renouvelable.

en.text: What is the Defender of Rights (Défenseur des droits)?
en.answer_hint: Independent administrative authority created in 2011. Defends citizens' rights and freedoms against administrations. 6-year non-renewable term.

tr.answer_hint: 2011'de kurulan bağımsız idari otorite. Vatandaşların idareye karşı hak ve özgürlüklerini savunur. 6 yıllık yenilenemez görev süresi.

questions.text_fr: Quels sont les services publics français ?
questions.answer_hint: Éducation, santé (hôpitaux, Sécurité sociale), justice, police, pompiers, transports (SNCF), poste, défense nationale. Financés par les impôts et cotisations.

en.text: What are the French public services?
en.answer_hint: Education, healthcare (hospitals, Social Security), justice, police, firefighters, transport (SNCF — French railways), post office, national defense. Funded by taxes and contributions.

tr.answer_hint: Eğitim, sağlık (hastaneler, Sosyal Güvenlik), adalet, polis, itfaiyeciler, ulaşım (SNCF — Fransız demiryolları), posta, ulusal savunma. Vergiler ve primlerle finanse edilir.

questions.text_fr: En quelle année a eu lieu la Révolution française ?
questions.answer_hint: 1789. La prise de la Bastille a lieu le 14 juillet 1789. La Déclaration des droits de l'homme et du citoyen est adoptée le 26 août 1789.

en.text: In what year did the French Revolution take place?
en.answer_hint: 1789. The storming of the Bastille happened on 14 July 1789. The Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen was adopted on 26 August 1789.

tr.answer_hint: 1789. Bastille'in fethi 14 Temmuz 1789'da gerçekleşti. İnsan ve Yurttaş Hakları Bildirgesi 26 Ağustos 1789'da kabul edildi.

questions.text_fr: Que s'est-il passé le 14 juillet 1789 ?
questions.answer_hint: Prise de la Bastille (prison royale, symbole de l'arbitraire). Événement déclencheur de la Révolution. Devenue fête nationale en 1880.

en.text: What happened on 14 July 1789?
en.answer_hint: Storming of the Bastille (royal prison, symbol of arbitrary power). Triggering event of the Revolution. Became the national holiday in 1880.

tr.answer_hint: Bastille'in fethi (kraliyet hapishanesi, keyfi gücün simgesi). Devrimi tetikleyen olay. 1880'de ulusal bayram oldu.

questions.text_fr: Qu'est-ce que la Déclaration des droits de l'homme et du citoyen ?
questions.answer_hint: Texte fondamental adopté le 26 août 1789. Proclame des droits universels : liberté, égalité, propriété, sûreté, résistance à l'oppression. Préambule de la Constitution actuelle.

en.text: What is the Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen?
en.answer_hint: Fundamental text adopted on 26 August 1789. Proclaims universal rights: liberty, equality, property, security, resistance to oppression. Preamble to the current Constitution.

tr.text: İnsan ve Yurttaş Hakları Bildirgesi nedir?
tr.answer_hint: 26 Ağustos 1789'da kabul edilen temel metin. Evrensel hakları ilan eder: özgürlük, eşitlik, mülkiyet, güvenlik, baskıya direniş. Mevcut Anayasanın önsözüdür.

questions.text_fr: Qui était Louis XIV ?
questions.answer_hint: Le Roi Soleil. Règne le plus long de France (1643-1715, 72 ans). Monarchie absolue, construction du château de Versailles, expansion militaire et culturelle.

en.text: Who was Louis XIV?
en.answer_hint: The Sun King. Longest reign in France (1643-1715, 72 years). Absolute monarchy, construction of the Palace of Versailles, military and cultural expansion.

tr.answer_hint: Güneş Kral. Fransa'nın en uzun saltanatı (1643-1715, 72 yıl). Mutlak monarşi, Versailles Sarayı'nın inşası, askeri ve kültürel genişleme.

questions.text_fr: Qui était Napoléon Bonaparte ?
questions.answer_hint: Général puis empereur des Français (1804-1814, 1815). A modernisé la France : Code civil (1804), lycées, préfectures, Légion d'honneur. Défaite à Waterloo (1815).

en.text: Who was Napoleon Bonaparte?
en.answer_hint: General then Emperor of the French (1804-1814, 1815). Modernized France: Civil Code (1804), lycées (state secondary schools), prefectures, Legion of Honor. Defeated at Waterloo (1815).

tr.answer_hint: Önce general, sonra Fransa İmparatoru (1804-1814, 1815). Fransa'yı modernleştirdi: Medeni Kanun (1804), liseler (lycées — devlet ortaöğretim), valilikler, Légion d'honneur. Waterloo'da yenildi (1815).

questions.text_fr: Qui était Charles de Gaulle ?
questions.answer_hint: Général, chef de la France libre durant la WWII (Appel du 18 juin 1940). Fondateur de la Ve République (1958), premier président élu au suffrage universel direct (1965). Décédé en 1970.

en.text: Who was Charles de Gaulle?
en.answer_hint: General, leader of Free France during WWII (Appeal of 18 June 1940). Founder of the Fifth Republic (1958), first president elected by direct universal suffrage (1965). Died in 1970.

tr.answer_hint: General, II. Dünya Savaşı sırasında Özgür Fransa'nın lideri (18 Haziran 1940 Çağrısı). Beşinci Cumhuriyet'in kurucusu (1958), doğrudan genel oyla seçilen ilk cumhurbaşkanı (1965). 1970'te öldü.

questions.text_fr: Qu'est-ce que l'appel du 18 juin 1940 ?
questions.answer_hint: Discours du général de Gaulle depuis Londres, appelant les Français à résister à l'occupation nazie. Acte fondateur de la Résistance.

en.text: What was the appeal of 18 June 1940?
en.answer_hint: Speech by General de Gaulle from London, calling on the French to resist Nazi occupation. Founding act of the Resistance.

tr.answer_hint: General de Gaulle'ün Londra'dan Fransızları Nazi işgaline direnmeye çağıran konuşması. Direnişin kurucu eylemi.

questions.text_fr: Quand a eu lieu la Seconde Guerre mondiale ?
questions.answer_hint: 1939-1945. La France entre en guerre en septembre 1939. Occupation allemande de 1940 à 1944. Libération de Paris : 25 août 1944.

en.text: When did World War II take place?
en.answer_hint: 1939-1945. France entered the war in September 1939. German occupation from 1940 to 1944. Liberation of Paris: 25 August 1944.

tr.text: II. Dünya Savaşı ne zaman yaşandı?
tr.answer_hint: 1939-1945. Fransa Eylül 1939'da savaşa girdi. 1940-1944 Alman işgali. Paris'in kurtuluşu: 25 Ağustos 1944.

questions.text_fr: Qu'est-ce que la Shoah ?
questions.answer_hint: Génocide des Juifs d'Europe perpétré par l'Allemagne nazie (1941-1945). Environ 6 millions de victimes. En France, ~76 000 Juifs déportés, dont 11 400 enfants. Rafle du Vél' d'Hiv (16-17 juillet 1942).

en.text: What was the Shoah?
en.answer_hint: Genocide of European Jews perpetrated by Nazi Germany (1941-1945). About 6 million victims. In France, ~76,000 Jews were deported, including 11,400 children. Vél' d'Hiv Roundup (16-17 July 1942).

tr.answer_hint: Nazi Almanyası tarafından gerçekleştirilen Avrupa Yahudilerinin soykırımı (1941-1945). Yaklaşık 6 milyon kurban. Fransa'da ~76 000 Yahudi sürgün edildi, bunların 11 400'ü çocuktu. Vél' d'Hiv Baskını (16-17 Temmuz 1942).

questions.text_fr: Qu'est-ce que la rafle du Vél' d'Hiv ?
questions.answer_hint: Arrestation massive de Juifs (13 152 personnes dont 4 115 enfants) les 16-17 juillet 1942 par la police française à Paris, sur ordre de l'occupant nazi. Reconnue comme crime de la France par Jacques Chirac en 1995.

en.text: What was the Vél' d'Hiv Roundup?
en.answer_hint: Mass arrest of Jews (13,152 people including 4,115 children) on 16-17 July 1942 by French police in Paris, on orders of the Nazi occupier. Recognized as a French state crime by Jacques Chirac in 1995.

tr.answer_hint: 16-17 Temmuz 1942'de Fransız polisinin Nazi işgalcinin emriyle Paris'te yaptığı toplu Yahudi tutuklaması (4115'i çocuk olmak üzere 13 152 kişi). 1995'te Jacques Chirac tarafından Fransız devlet suçu olarak tanındı.

questions.text_fr: Qu'est-ce que la Résistance ?
questions.answer_hint: Mouvement de lutte contre l'occupation allemande et le régime de Vichy entre 1940 et 1944. Personnages clés : de Gaulle, Jean Moulin (unificateur, mort en martyr en 1943), Lucie Aubrac.

en.text: What was the Resistance?
en.answer_hint: Movement against German occupation and the Vichy regime between 1940 and 1944. Key figures: de Gaulle, Jean Moulin (unifier, martyred in 1943), Lucie Aubrac.

tr.answer_hint: 1940-1944 arasında Alman işgaline ve Vichy rejimine karşı mücadele hareketi. Kilit figürler: de Gaulle, Jean Moulin (birleştirici, 1943'te şehit), Lucie Aubrac.

questions.text_fr: Quand la France a-t-elle été libérée ?
questions.answer_hint: Paris libéré le 25 août 1944. Capitulation allemande : 8 mai 1945 (V-E Day). Le 8 mai est jour férié en France.

en.text: When was France liberated?
en.answer_hint: Paris liberated on 25 August 1944. German surrender: 8 May 1945 (V-E Day). 8 May is a public holiday in France.

tr.answer_hint: Paris 25 Ağustos 1944'te kurtarıldı. Almanya'nın teslimi: 8 Mayıs 1945 (Zafer Günü). 8 Mayıs Fransa'da resmi tatildir.

questions.text_fr: Quand la Première Guerre mondiale a-t-elle eu lieu ?
questions.answer_hint: 1914-1918. Armistice signé le 11 novembre 1918 à Rethondes. Environ 1,4 million de soldats français tués. Jour férié : 11 novembre.

en.text: When did World War I take place?
en.answer_hint: 1914-1918. Armistice signed on 11 November 1918 at Rethondes. About 1.4 million French soldiers killed. Public holiday: 11 November.

tr.text: I. Dünya Savaşı ne zaman yaşandı?
tr.answer_hint: 1914-1918. Ateşkes 11 Kasım 1918'de Rethondes'te imzalandı. Yaklaşık 1,4 milyon Fransız asker hayatını kaybetti. Resmi tatil: 11 Kasım.

questions.text_fr: Quand la peine de mort a-t-elle été abolie en France ?
questions.answer_hint: Le 9 octobre 1981, sous la présidence de François Mitterrand, à l'initiative du garde des Sceaux Robert Badinter. Inscrite dans la Constitution en 2007.

en.text: When was the death penalty abolished in France?
en.answer_hint: 9 October 1981, under President François Mitterrand, at the initiative of Justice Minister Robert Badinter. Enshrined in the Constitution in 2007.

tr.text: Fransa'da idam cezası ne zaman kaldırıldı?
tr.answer_hint: 9 Ekim 1981'de, Cumhurbaşkanı François Mitterrand döneminde, Adalet Bakanı Robert Badinter'in girişimiyle. 2007'de Anayasa'ya eklendi.

questions.text_fr: Quand les femmes ont-elles obtenu le droit de vote en France ?
questions.answer_hint: Le 21 avril 1944 par ordonnance du général de Gaulle (Comité français de libération nationale, Alger). Premier vote féminin : 29 avril 1945, élections municipales.

en.text: When did women obtain the right to vote in France?
en.answer_hint: 21 April 1944 by ordinance of General de Gaulle (French Committee of National Liberation, Algiers). First women's vote: 29 April 1945, municipal elections.

tr.text: Fransa'da kadınlar oy hakkını ne zaman kazandı?
tr.answer_hint: 21 Nisan 1944'te General de Gaulle'ün kararnamesiyle (Fransız Ulusal Kurtuluş Komitesi, Cezayir). İlk kadın oyu: 29 Nisan 1945, belediye seçimleri.

questions.text_fr: Qui était Simone Veil ?
questions.answer_hint: Femme politique, survivante d'Auschwitz, ministre de la Santé qui a fait adopter la loi sur l'IVG (17 janvier 1975). Première présidente du Parlement européen (1979). Panthéonisée en 2018.

en.text: Who was Simone Veil?
en.answer_hint: Politician, Auschwitz survivor, Health Minister who passed the abortion law (17 January 1975). First female president of the European Parliament (1979). Entered the Pantheon in 2018.

tr.answer_hint: Politikacı, Auschwitz hayatta kalanı, kürtaj yasasını çıkartan Sağlık Bakanı (17 Ocak 1975). Avrupa Parlamentosu'nun ilk kadın başkanı (1979). 2018'de Panthéon'a defnedildi.

questions.text_fr: Qui était Jeanne d'Arc ?
questions.answer_hint: Héroïne nationale française (1412-1431). A libéré Orléans face aux Anglais durant la Guerre de Cent Ans. Brûlée à Rouen en 1431. Canonisée en 1920. Symbole patriotique.

en.text: Who was Joan of Arc?
en.answer_hint: French national heroine (1412-1431). Liberated Orléans from the English during the Hundred Years' War. Burned at Rouen in 1431. Canonized in 1920. Patriotic symbol.

tr.answer_hint: Fransız ulusal kahramanı (1412-1431). Yüz Yıl Savaşları sırasında Orléans'ı İngilizlerden kurtardı. 1431'de Rouen'de yakıldı. 1920'de aziz ilan edildi. Vatansever sembol.

questions.text_fr: Qu'est-ce que la Guerre de Cent Ans ?
questions.answer_hint: Conflit entre la France et l'Angleterre, 1337-1453. Causes : succession au trône de France. Jeanne d'Arc joue un rôle clé. La France récupère ses territoires (sauf Calais).

en.text: What was the Hundred Years' War?
en.answer_hint: Conflict between France and England, 1337-1453. Cause: succession to the French throne. Joan of Arc plays a key role. France recovered its territories (except Calais).

tr.answer_hint: Fransa ile İngiltere arasında 1337-1453 çatışması. Nedeni: Fransa tahtına veraset. Jeanne d'Arc kilit rol oynar. Fransa topraklarını geri aldı (Calais hariç).

questions.text_fr: Qui était Vercingétorix ?
questions.answer_hint: Chef gaulois, premier héros national. A uni les tribus gauloises contre Jules César. Vaincu à Alésia en 52 av. J.-C. Symbole de résistance.

en.text: Who was Vercingetorix?
en.answer_hint: Gallic chief, first national hero. United Gallic tribes against Julius Caesar. Defeated at Alesia in 52 BCE. Symbol of resistance.

tr.answer_hint: Galli şefi, ilk ulusal kahraman. Galli kabileleri Jül Sezar'a karşı birleştirdi. MÖ 52'de Alesia'da yenildi. Direniş simgesi.

questions.text_fr: Qu'est-ce que la colonisation française ?
questions.answer_hint: Expansion territoriale du XVIIe au XXe siècle (Afrique, Asie, Amériques). Empire colonial parmi les plus vastes. Décolonisation principalement après 1945. Mémoire douloureuse (Algérie notamment).

en.text: What was French colonization?
en.answer_hint: Territorial expansion from the 17th to 20th centuries (Africa, Asia, Americas). One of the largest colonial empires. Decolonization mainly after 1945. Painful memory (notably Algeria).

tr.answer_hint: 17. ila 20. yüzyıllarda toprak genişlemesi (Afrika, Asya, Amerika). En büyük sömürge imparatorluklarından biri. Sömürgesizleşme esas olarak 1945'ten sonra. Acılı bir hatıra (özellikle Cezayir).

questions.text_fr: Quand l'Algérie a-t-elle obtenu son indépendance ?
questions.answer_hint: Le 5 juillet 1962, après une guerre d'indépendance (1954-1962). Accords d'Évian signés le 18 mars 1962. Mémoire encore vive (harkis, pieds-noirs).

en.text: When did Algeria gain independence?
en.answer_hint: 5 July 1962, after a war of independence (1954-1962). Évian Accords signed on 18 March 1962. Still vivid memory (harkis, pieds-noirs).

tr.answer_hint: Bir bağımsızlık savaşının (1954-1962) ardından 5 Temmuz 1962'de. Évian Anlaşması 18 Mart 1962'de imzalandı. Hâlâ canlı bir hatıra (harkiler, pieds-noirs).

questions.text_fr: Qu'est-ce que la Ve République ?
questions.answer_hint: Régime politique actuel, fondé en 1958 par le général de Gaulle. Constitution renforçant les pouvoirs du président. Quinquennat depuis 2000.

en.text: What is the Fifth Republic?
en.answer_hint: Current political regime, founded in 1958 by General de Gaulle. Constitution strengthening presidential powers. 5-year term since 2000.

tr.answer_hint: Mevcut siyasi rejim, 1958'de General de Gaulle tarafından kuruldu. Cumhurbaşkanı yetkilerini güçlendiren anayasa. 2000'den beri 5 yıllık görev süresi.

questions.text_fr: Combien de Républiques la France a-t-elle connues ?

en.text: How many Republics has France had?

questions.text_fr: Qui était Victor Schoelcher ?
questions.answer_hint: Homme politique abolitionniste. Auteur du décret du 27 avril 1848 abolissant définitivement l'esclavage en France et dans les colonies. Panthéonisé en 1949.

en.text: Who was Victor Schoelcher?
en.answer_hint: Abolitionist politician. Author of the decree of 27 April 1848 definitively abolishing slavery in France and its colonies. Entered the Pantheon in 1949.

tr.answer_hint: Köleliği kaldırma yanlısı politikacı. Fransa ve sömürgelerinde köleliği kesin olarak kaldıran 27 Nisan 1848 kararnamesinin yazarı. 1949'da Panthéon'a defnedildi.

questions.text_fr: Quand l'esclavage a-t-il été aboli en France ?
questions.answer_hint: Une première fois en 1794, rétabli par Napoléon en 1802, définitivement aboli par le décret du 27 avril 1848 (Schoelcher). Journée commémorative : 10 mai (loi Taubira, 2001).

en.text: When was slavery abolished in France?
en.answer_hint: First in 1794, reinstated by Napoleon in 1802, definitively abolished by the decree of 27 April 1848 (Schoelcher). Commemoration day: 10 May (Taubira law, 2001).

tr.answer_hint: İlk olarak 1794'te, Napolyon tarafından 1802'de yeniden getirildi, 27 Nisan 1848 kararnamesiyle (Schoelcher) kesin olarak kaldırıldı. Anma günü: 10 Mayıs (Taubira yasası, 2001).

questions.text_fr: Qu'est-ce que la loi de séparation des Églises et de l'État ?
questions.answer_hint: Loi du 9 décembre 1905, fondement de la laïcité française. L'État ne reconnaît, ne salarie ni ne subventionne aucun culte. Liberté de conscience garantie.

en.text: What is the law of separation of Church and State?
en.answer_hint: Law of 9 December 1905, foundation of French laïcité (secularism). The state neither recognizes, pays salaries to, nor subsidizes any religion. Freedom of conscience guaranteed.

tr.text: Kilise ve Devletin Ayrılması Yasası nedir?
tr.answer_hint: 9 Aralık 1905 yasası, Fransız laïcité (laiklik) temeli. Devlet hiçbir dini tanımaz, maaş ödemez veya desteklemez. Vicdan özgürlüğü güvence altındadır.

questions.text_fr: Qu'est-ce que les Trente Glorieuses ?
questions.answer_hint: Période de forte croissance économique en France, 1945-1975. Expression de l'économiste Jean Fourastié. Plein emploi, baby-boom, modernisation, consommation de masse.

en.text: What were the Trente Glorieuses?
en.answer_hint: Period of strong economic growth in France, 1945-1975. Expression by economist Jean Fourastié. Full employment, baby boom, modernization, mass consumption.

tr.answer_hint: Fransa'da 1945-1975 arası güçlü ekonomik büyüme dönemi. Ekonomist Jean Fourastié'nin ifadesi. Tam istihdam, baby boom, modernleşme, kitle tüketimi.

questions.text_fr: Qu'était Mai 68 ?
questions.answer_hint: Mouvement social et culturel de mai-juin 1968 : grève générale, occupations universitaires, contestation du pouvoir gaullien. Marque la libéralisation des mœurs.

en.text: What was May 68?
en.answer_hint: Social and cultural movement of May-June 1968: general strike, university occupations, protest against Gaullist power. Marks the liberalization of morals.

tr.answer_hint: Mayıs-Haziran 1968 sosyal ve kültürel hareketi: genel grev, üniversite işgalleri, Gaulle iktidarına itiraz. Ahlakın liberalleşmesini işaret eder.

questions.text_fr: Qui a écrit La Marseillaise ?
questions.answer_hint: Rouget de Lisle, officier français, en 1792 à Strasbourg. Chant de guerre destiné aux soldats de l'armée du Rhin. Devenu hymne national en 1795.

en.text: Who wrote La Marseillaise?
en.answer_hint: Rouget de Lisle, French officer, in 1792 in Strasbourg. War song for soldiers of the Army of the Rhine. Became the national anthem in 1795.

tr.answer_hint: 1792'de Strazburg'da Fransız subayı Rouget de Lisle. Ren Ordusu askerleri için savaş şarkısı. 1795'te ulusal marş oldu.

questions.text_fr: Qu'est-ce que le Panthéon ?
questions.answer_hint: Monument du Quartier latin à Paris. Nécropole des grands hommes de la République. Y reposent : Voltaire, Rousseau, Hugo, Zola, Curie, Schoelcher, Veil, Manouchian, etc.

en.text: What is the Pantheon?
en.answer_hint: Monument in the Latin Quarter of Paris. Necropolis of great figures of the Republic. Resting place of: Voltaire, Rousseau, Hugo, Zola, Curie, Schoelcher, Veil, Manouchian, etc.

tr.answer_hint: Paris Quartier latin'deki anıt. Cumhuriyetin büyük şahsiyetlerinin türbesi. Burada gömülüler: Voltaire, Rousseau, Hugo, Zola, Curie, Schoelcher, Veil, Manouchian, vb.

questions.text_fr: Qu'est-ce que les Lumières ?
questions.answer_hint: Mouvement intellectuel du XVIIIe siècle. Penseurs majeurs : Voltaire, Rousseau, Diderot, Montesquieu. Valeurs : raison, liberté, tolérance, progrès. Influence sur la Révolution.

en.text: What was the Enlightenment (Les Lumières)?
en.answer_hint: Intellectual movement of the 18th century. Major thinkers: Voltaire, Rousseau, Diderot, Montesquieu. Values: reason, freedom, tolerance, progress. Influence on the Revolution.

tr.answer_hint: 18. yüzyıl entelektüel hareketi. Başlıca düşünürler: Voltaire, Rousseau, Diderot, Montesquieu. Değerler: akıl, özgürlük, hoşgörü, ilerleme. Devrim üzerinde etki.

questions.text_fr: Quels sont les présidents marquants de la Ve République ?
questions.answer_hint: Charles de Gaulle (1959-1969), Georges Pompidou (1969-1974), Valéry Giscard d'Estaing (1974-1981), François Mitterrand (1981-1995), Jacques Chirac (1995-2007), Nicolas Sarkozy (2007-2012), François Hollande (2012-2017), Emmanuel Macron (2017-).

en.text: Who are the notable presidents of the Fifth Republic?
en.answer_hint: Charles de Gaulle (1959-1969), Georges Pompidou (1969-1974), Valéry Giscard d'Estaing (1974-1981), François Mitterrand (1981-1995), Jacques Chirac (1995-2007), Nicolas Sarkozy (2007-2012), François Hollande (2012-2017), Emmanuel Macron (2017-).

tr.text: Beşinci Cumhuriyet'in önde gelen cumhurbaşkanları kimlerdir?
tr.answer_hint: Charles de Gaulle (1959-1969), Georges Pompidou (1969-1974), Valéry Giscard d'Estaing (1974-1981), François Mitterrand (1981-1995), Jacques Chirac (1995-2007), Nicolas Sarkozy (2007-2012), François Hollande (2012-2017), Emmanuel Macron (2017-).

questions.text_fr: Quand l'euro est-il devenu monnaie en France ?
questions.answer_hint: 1er janvier 1999 (en comptabilité), 1er janvier 2002 (pièces et billets en circulation). Remplace le franc français.

en.text: When did the euro become French currency?
en.answer_hint: 1 January 1999 (in accounting), 1 January 2002 (coins and notes in circulation). Replaced the French franc.

tr.text: Euro Fransa'da ne zaman para birimi oldu?
tr.answer_hint: 1 Ocak 1999 (muhasebede), 1 Ocak 2002 (dolaşımda madeni ve banknotlar). Fransız frangının yerini aldı.

questions.text_fr: Qu'est-ce que le débarquement du 6 juin 1944 ?
questions.answer_hint: Débarquement allié en Normandie (D-Day). Plus grande opération amphibie de l'histoire. ~156 000 soldats. Début de la libération de la France. Plages : Utah, Omaha, Gold, Juno, Sword.

en.text: What was the landing of 6 June 1944?
en.answer_hint: Allied landing in Normandy (D-Day). Largest amphibious operation in history. ~156,000 soldiers. Beginning of France's liberation. Beaches: Utah, Omaha, Gold, Juno, Sword.

tr.answer_hint: Normandiya'da Müttefik çıkarması (D-Day). Tarihin en büyük amfibi operasyonu. ~156 000 asker. Fransa'nın kurtuluşunun başlangıcı. Plajlar: Utah, Omaha, Gold, Juno, Sword.

questions.text_fr: Qui était Robert Schuman ?
questions.answer_hint: Homme politique français, ministre des Affaires étrangères, à l'origine de la Déclaration du 9 mai 1950 (création de la CECA, embryon de l'UE). « Père de l'Europe ».

en.text: Who was Robert Schuman?
en.answer_hint: French statesman, Minister of Foreign Affairs, origin of the Declaration of 9 May 1950 (creation of the ECSC, embryo of the EU). "Father of Europe".

tr.answer_hint: Fransız devlet adamı, Dışişleri Bakanı, 9 Mayıs 1950 Bildirgesinin (AKÇT'nin kurulması, AB'nin embriyosu) kaynağı. "Avrupa'nın Babası".

questions.text_fr: Que célèbre-t-on le 8 mai et le 11 novembre ?
questions.answer_hint: 8 mai : victoire de 1945 (fin WWII en Europe). 11 novembre : armistice de 1918 (fin WWI). Tous deux jours fériés.

en.text: What is celebrated on 8 May and 11 November?
en.answer_hint: 8 May: victory of 1945 (end of WWII in Europe). 11 November: armistice of 1918 (end of WWI). Both public holidays.

tr.answer_hint: 8 Mayıs: 1945 zaferi (Avrupa'da II. Dünya Savaşı'nın sonu). 11 Kasım: 1918 ateşkesi (I. Dünya Savaşı'nın sonu). İkisi de resmi tatil.

questions.text_fr: Qu'est-ce que l'Empire colonial français ?
